GTA 6 release time in Hong Kong, Hong Kong

On Nov 19, 2026 at 00:00, the regional PlayStation Store launch reference for Hong Kong reaches its target. The countdown above tracks that exact absolute timestamp. The city’s IANA time zone is Asia/Hong_Kong, so no manual daylight-saving adjustment is required.

Hong Kong: Nov 19, 2026 at 00:00 · HK STORE

Which release time should you trust?

Rockstar confirms a November 19, 2026 release at midnight local time, but it does not publish a separate instant for every city. The clock shown here is the converted timestamp of the HK store region. This distinction is particularly important in countries with multiple time zones.

How to prepare for launch

Verify your account region on the PlayStation Store or Xbox Store, install any available preload, and check the unlock time directly on the product page. The countdown is informative, not an access guarantee.

Source transparency: Rockstar Support states midnight local time on 19 November. Individual timestamps are organized from regional PlayStation Store listings. For places with several time zones, the displayed clock can reflect the country store rather than each city’s midnight. Check the console store for the definitive time. How to read this tracker

Three things to keep in mind:

  1. Official date: Nov 19, 2026.
  2. Time: local midnight according to Rockstar; specific store timestamps vary.
  3. Window reached: a scheduled time has passed, not proof that servers are accessible.

// FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What time does GTA 6 unlock in Hong Kong?

The regional store reference converts to Nov 19, 2026 at 00:00 in Hong Kong, Hong Kong (Asia/Hong_Kong). Check the exact listing on your console.

Why does Hong Kong have a different time from another city?

Countries and store regions can use a single launch timestamp even where multiple local time zones exist. This tracker converts that timestamp using the IANA Asia/Hong_Kong time zone.

Is GTA VI launching on PC on November 19?

No. Rockstar announced the November 19, 2026 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no confirmed PC release date.
